title: Home · Devices
description: Batteries, radio links and silent sensors.

targets.query:
import "dict"
names = ["D7353530665A": "Living room", "D63534385106": "Office", "D83535301C43": "Upstairs office", "C76A05062842": "Bedroom", "D7353530520F": "Ada's room", "D83431306571": "Upstairs bathroom", "CE2A82463674": "Downstairs bathroom", "D83534387029": "Front yard", "D9353438450D": "Backyard", "D4343037362D": "Patio", "C76A03460A73": "Storage", "C76A0246647E": "Car", "C76A0306280B": "Fridge", "D43535302778": "Freezer", "CE2A83062A34": "Filament dryer", "C76A00462055": "AMS 1", "C76A05065C4E": "AMS 2", "CE2A82463295": "Drybox 1", "D9343130222A": "Drybox 2", "CE2A8486490B": "Drybox 3"]
ble = from(bucket: "home")
  |> range(start: -14d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer" and r._field == "batt")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.device_id, set: ["D7353530665A", "D63534385106", "D83535301C43", "C76A05062842", "D7353530520F", "D83431306571", "CE2A82463674", "D83534387029", "D9353438450D", "D4343037362D", "C76A03460A73", "C76A0246647E", "C76A0306280B", "D43535302778", "CE2A83062A34", "C76A00462055", "C76A05065C4E", "CE2A82463295", "D9343130222A", "CE2A8486490B"]))
  |> group(columns: ["device_id"]) |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({device: dict.get(dict: names, key: r.device_id, default: r.device_id), kind: "SwitchBot (BLE)", battery: float(v: r._value), seen: r._time}))
zigbee = from(bucket: "home")
  |> range(start: -14d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer" and r.integration_id == "zigbee2mqtt" and r._field == "battery")
  |> group(columns: ["device_id"]) |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({device: r.device_id, kind: "Zigbee", battery: float(v: r._value), seen: r._time}))
union(tables: [ble, zigbee])
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with hours: float(v: int(v: now()) - int(v: r.seen)) / 3600000000000.0}))
  |> sort(columns: ["battery"])
